newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar softens to cenbank-set ceiling.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar softens to cenbank-set ceiling.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar softened in moderate trade to a Central Bank-set 471.25/472.24 bolivar per dollar ceiling, traders said.
On Monday, the unit closed at 471.00/472.00 per dollar.
"The Central Bank came in, drop by drop, holding the exchange rate at that level," said one trader.
Brokers saw little change for Wednesday, despite an expected slight fall in yields at the Central Bank's 30 billion bolivar TEM auction.
